pulcherrimi ingenii monumenta, ad eo ut amussim vi-
deatur secutus illud consilium, quod [illegible, ~6 letters] I Cuja-
cius filio suo unico praescripsit aliquando in praefatione
Pofter. tract. ad Afric. ut cognosceret ea quae Philosophi
scripserunt, non ea tantum parte, quae ad jus pertinet,

Et huic quidem in finem adolescens adhuc G. Ophanius noster.

page.notes: The Greek-like mark after "quod" is illegible. "G. Ophanius" is uncertain (probably Gruphanius/Gyphanius, name of the author, as printed). Several words in the italic passage (m-gnis, quaesiliciter, viridi docti, obscuram) are doubtful and not corrected. The word "noster" at the foot right is treated as a catchword. Digitiser watermark excluded.
